answers.rationale: Fly into AVL and rent there. Asheville is the local airport for Arden; CLT, GSP, and ATL add unnecessary ground travel and more exposure before a Tuesday-morning onsite item. This is a location-and-schedule decision, not a fixed airport preference.

Fly Sunday and book Sunday night. A required Monday 10 a.m. crate inspection needs pre-positioning and recovery margin; Monday-morning arrival or a red-eye makes the inspection fragile, while Saturday adds an unnecessary extra night.

Fly Monday and book Monday night only. With no Monday crate, badge, or other onsite requirement and a Tuesday-noon setup, Monday arrival provides a normal preparation buffer without paying for unnecessary Sunday or Saturday nights. Tuesday-morning travel adds avoidable same-day setup risk.

Fly Tuesday and book Tuesday night. An 8 a.m. Wednesday freight handoff and badge pickup requires being in Baltimore the prior evening; Sunday or Monday arrivals add unnecessary hotel nights, while a Wednesday-dawn arrival is too brittle for the first required task.
